summary.text: Aaron Thomas is the Republican candidate for Alabama House of Representatives District 10 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Marilyn Lands (D).
A small business owner, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is a husband, father of two young daughters and a business owner.

paragraphs.text: Aaron Thomas earned an associate degree from Calhoun Community College and bachelor's and graduate degrees from California Coast University, and his career experience includes working as a small business owner.
The Republican primary for District 10 on May 19, 2026, was canceled, and he advanced without appearing on the ballot.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Thomas said he believes in free market principles, affordable living, transparency from elected officials, strong families and limited government.
He named educational choice, school safety, affordable living and an economy that works for large and small businesses as policy priorities.
He listed the Alabama Farmers Federation and the Alabama Forestry Association as endorsers.
